description.register: Set up a passkey for "{{username}}". You will use it to sign in from now on, without a password.

error.aborted: Cancelled. Press "Create passkey" again and confirm your device’s prompt.
error.already-registered: This device already holds a passkey for this account. Sign in with it instead of creating another.
error.authenticator-error: Your device could not create a passkey. Check that a screen lock or PIN is set up.
error.insecure-context: Passkeys only work over a secure connection. Open the link via HTTPS or localhost.
error.invalid-token: This registration link is invalid or has expired. Start the sign-up again to get a new one.
error.rejected: The passkey could not be stored. The link may have expired or already been used.
error.unknown: The passkey could not be created. Please try again.
error.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys. Open the link in an up-to-date Chrome, Firefox or Safari.
error.wrong-domain: The link belongs to a different address than the one the page is running under.
